Japanese Delegation Explores Investment in Uttar Pradesh

A delegation of over 200 Japanese individuals, led by Yamanashi Governor Kotaro Nagasaki, arrived in Uttar Pradesh for a five-day investment meet. The delegation is exploring opportunities in green energy, semiconductors, skills development, and tourism. The event aims to drive manufacturing, technology, and job creation in the state. Union Minister Vaishnaw pitched Uttar Pradesh as a base for Japanese electronics and semiconductor investment. The delegation received a welcome in Jewar, marking a new chapter in India-Japan relations.
